title: Luke 4:1-4 — Jesus tempted to turn stone to bread: lust of the flesh
summary: Luke 4:1-4 in English: Jesus, led by the Spirit in the wilderness forty days, is tempted by the devil to turn a stone into bread and answers that man shall not live on bread alone. The word “bread” is highlighted and the slide labels this temptation “Lust of the Flesh”.

text.text: 1 Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan and was led around by the Spirit in the wilderness
2 for forty days, being tempted by the devil.
3 And the devil said to Him, “If You are the Son of God, tell this stone to become bread.”
4 And Jesus answered him, “It is written, ‘MAN SHALL NOT LIVE ON BREAD ALONE.’”

numbers.note: forty days of temptation in the wilderness

keywords: man shall not live by bread alone
uncertain: The source line reads “Deuteronomy 4:4”; the quotation “Man shall not live on bread alone” is actually Deuteronomy 8:3. Transcribed as shown.
